name: conjure
title: Conjure
description: Conjure images, edits, upscales, and videos through fal.ai — directly from Raycast.
author: guimaraes

commands.name: create-image
commands.title: Create Image
commands.description: Generate images with fal.ai text-to-image models.

commands.name: edit-image
commands.title: Edit Image
commands.description: Edit images with fal.ai image-to-image models.

commands.name: upscale-image
commands.title: Upscale Image
commands.description: Upscale or enhance an image with fal.ai upscaling models.

commands.name: create-video
commands.title: Create Video
commands.description: Generate videos with fal.ai text-to-video and image-to-video models.

commands.name: recent-generations
commands.title: Recent Generations
commands.description: Browse, copy, and download recent fal.ai outputs.

commands.name: worker
commands.title: Conjure Worker
commands.description: Background job runner used internally by Conjure. Not meant to be launched directly.

preferences.name: falKey
preferences.title: FAL API Key
preferences.description: fal.ai API key. Leave empty to fall back to the FAL_KEY environment variable.

preferences.name: downloadDirectory
preferences.title: Download Folder
preferences.description: Default folder for outputs from jobs without a local input file (Create Image, Text-to-Video). Defaults to ~/Downloads. Jobs with a local input file always save next to the input.
